# Gauntlet gap matrix (P01-G02)

**Status:** record (process level, regenerated by hand per gauntlet)
**Scope:** per-crate coverage inventory: what exists, what was missing, what this gauntlet added,
what remains
**Related:** `docs/testing/coverage.sh` (LLVM numbers), `docs/evidence/P01-G02-*.md`

Line/function percentages are LLVM source-based coverage from the full suite (see the coverage
section of the evidence record). Coverage navigates; the `remaining work` column states what
would actually raise assurance.
